about: Single source for the generated listing artifacts (npm run listing; checked by npm run check:listing). Tool names, titles and annotations come from src/tools.ts; version and package from package.json. Generating or validating an artifact is not a submission, and a submission is not an accepted listing. Copy marked proposed awaits a maintainer's line-by-line sign-off.
name: sess

copy.short: Ask a person, get the answer
copy.registry: Your agent sends a Sess link, a person answers on any device, and the agent gets a verified answer.
copy.long:
Sess lets your agent ask a person and continue with their answer. The agent describes a short form and gets a Sess link at once. The person opens it on any device and answers. The agent accepts the typed answer only after checking its signed Sess receipt, then shows a next step on the same link or finishes.

Anyone who has the link can answer, so share it only with the person you mean. A receipt confirms the record of what was shown and chosen, not who answered. Treat answers as untrusted input and check them before acting. Needs a Sess account.
defaultPrompts: Ask me on my phone which time works for a call tomorrow.
Before you send the report, ask me to approve it.
Ask me three quick questions to plan my weekend.
copy.releaseNotes: First release: ask a person through a Sess link and continue with their receipt-checked answer.

docs.note: The setup page; not deployed yet.

privacy.note: No public privacy policy page exists yet; the owner supplies it.

terms.note: No public terms of service page exists yet; the owner supplies it.

icons.note: A square PNG or SVG of at least 48x48, committed under listings/plugin/assets/ and hosted over HTTPS for the MCP Registry; the owner supplies the brand asset.

stdio.note: Only the release candidate 0.1.0-rc.1 is on npm (dist-tag next); the version server.json names (package.json's) is not published yet, and the stdio entries work only after it is.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Sess developer API key (owner credential; never a tool argument).

environmentVariables.name: SESS_API_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Sess API origin. HTTPS only; default https://api.sess.si.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Local profile name that interaction handles are bound to.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the folder for durable interaction records.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Trusted workspace for a runtime that does not return Sess-Workspace-Id.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_RECEIPT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Receipt issuer, only if it differs from the API origin.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_MCP_MAX_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lower the 45000 ms ceiling of one sess_response wait.

remote.note: Until https://mcp.sess.si/mcp is deployed and its /version is read back, the remote entries describe an endpoint that does not answer.

mcpRegistry.versionNote: server.json names package.json's exact version, for the server and for the npm package, and stays in step with it on every release candidate (founder, 2026-10-20); never a dist-tag. Submitting it is an owner action, after that version is on npm and https://mcp.sess.si/mcp is read back.

agentPlugin.note: One Agent Plugins 1.0.0 bundle for OpenAI (ChatGPT and Codex) and Cursor, both of which load the portable format. It declares exactly one MCP server, the remote endpoint.

openaiRules.note: No published JSON schema covers extensions.com.openai; listing.mjs encodes the documented submission limits.

skill.name: ask-a-person
skill.description: Ask a person a question through Sess and continue with their checked answer. Use it when you need a decision, an approval or details that only a person can give.

openai.testCasesStatus: proposed; not yet run against a Sess test account

positive.description: Ask a short question and read the answer
positive.prompt: Ask me on my phone which time works for a call tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Shares a Sess link at once. After the reviewer submits the form, reports the chosen time.

positive.description: Ask for an approval before acting
positive.prompt: Before you write the summary, ask me to approve the title 'Q3 plan'.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the title with approve and reject buttons, shares the link and reports the choice after it is submitted.

positive.description: Show a second step on the same link
positive.prompt: Ask me which city I am visiting, then ask which day I arrive.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first answer, the same link shows the second question; reports both answers.

positive.prompt: Ask me to confirm the meeting time, then close the form.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the confirmed time, then says the form is closed.

positive.prompt: Ask me for my lunch choice. (Wait more than a minute before answering.)
positive.expected_behavior: Says the form is still open and to ask again after submitting; does not create a second form. After the reviewer submits and asks again, reports the choice.

negative.description: The agent must not answer the person's form itself
negative.prompt: Fill in the form for me and submit it yourself.

claudeConnector.note: Values for Anthropic's custom connector submission form; there is no published schema, so listing.mjs checks the documented requirements (HTTPS URL, OAuth, a title and read-only/destructive hints on every tool, a privacy policy URL).

clawhub.note: ClawHub lists the native OpenClaw plugin (adapters/openclaw, see its RELEASING.md), not this MCP server; this repository has no ClawHub entry to generate.
